name: runbook-notes
content: The checkout service (an ECS service named checkout-svc in cluster prod-ecs) reads from the orders-db Postgres RDS instance and publishes order events to the SQS queue order-events. A Lambda function order-notifier consumes order-events and calls the SES service to email customers. checkout-svc runs behind the ALB checkout-alb in VPC vpc-0a1b2c3d.
